## What is missing?

Describe the process or resource you could not find.

## Why is it needed?

Explain the operational problem this should solve.

## Who uses this?

List the team, role, or people who need it.

## Current process

Describe how the work is handled today, if known.

## Existing related documents

List any SOPs, checklists, templates, policies, guides, or references that may already be related.

## Suggested document type

- [ ] SOP
- [ ] Checklist
- [ ] Template
- [ ] Policy
- [ ] Guide
- [ ] Reference
- [ ] Not sure

> Before creating a new document, the reviewer will check whether the correct action is to update or link an existing canonical document.
